title: passiflora vesicaria var. galapagensis
intro: Passiflora vesicaria var. galapagensis, commonly known as Galapagos Passionflower, is a variant of the Passiflora vesicaria plant species, native to the Galapagos Islands. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its calming effects. Although more research is needed, Galapagos Passionflower has been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness.
